Arden Hills Wedding DJ

Mr & Mrs Santos at Arden Hills Country Club & Spa, Wedding Disc Jockey
Sacramento DJ

Ceremony DJ Wedding (Timeline for Ceremonies)

1. Background music – Pride and Prejudice – Dawn
Oceans (Where Feet May Fail) (Radio Version) – Hillsong United https://play.google.com/store/music/album?id=Bnqvolxakiyecfazm2psrvydegu&tid=song-Tlhtki4zv7yfuubec66qt6elq7y
The Cello Song – Piano Guys Pride and Prejudice – Stars and Butterflies
Pride and Prejudice – The Secret Life of Daydreams
Pride and Prejudice – Liz on Top of the World
Pride and Prejudice – Mrs. Darcy
Beethoven’s 5 Secrets – OneRepublic (Cello/Orchestral Cover) – ThePianoGuys – ://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mJ_fkw5j-t0

2. Seating of the parents-Officiant – Groomsman March.- Anne of Green Gables Main Theme – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0GmLi7w6WFY

3. Wedding Party March-Flower Girl- Ring Bearer – Maid of Honor – Pachelbel – Canon in D Major (Jean-Francois Paillard Chamber Orchestra)

4. Processional : Bride Walks Down the Aisle with her Father – Ever After – just up to 1:54 (it’s a short aisle)

5. Vows – None

5 ½ . Communion/Unity Candle – Special Track

6. Recessional – Phillip Phillips – Home

_

Stay around in the Villa for pictures:
Immediate family, grandparents, Bridal party (flower girls, too)

_______________________________________________________________________

Reception DJ Music(Timeline for Wedding Receptions)

Please fill out the wedding adlibs and leave on the table when you’re done.

1. Cocktail Hour – Michael Buble/Frank Sinatra/Nat King Cole type music
2. Arrival of the Wedding Party Grand Entrance – Chariots of Fire Main Theme (Massimo Visconti remix)

→ Announce – Lord of the Rings – theme song
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ovxbXaJs-90 (at 4:10-4:36)

Vanessa Gonsalez and Jeffrey Santos
Rebekah Thomas and Phillip Santos
Doris Johnson and Matthew Mantel (Man-TEL)
Kaylah Ailman and Johnathan Jonker (YON-ker)
Anne Crockett and Jason McMillan
Sarah Jelicich (Jel-i-SICH) and Blake Riser
Rebeca Garcia and Nathan Boyd

Mr & Mrs Santos
Newlyweds Applause

3. Wedding Jazz Background Type – Dinner Is Served-Dinner Music- Sinatra/Nat King Cole/Michael Buble/Father of the Bride type music

4. Toast Best Man Maid of Honor Speech – Background jazzy music/Sinatra/Michael Buble
5. 1st Dance – “Two is Better than One” – Boys Like Girls and Taylor Swift
Father/Daughter – “My Girl” – The Temptations
Mother/Son Dance – Rod Stewart – “Forever Young”
* ALL Guests dance – “Interlude” – Attack Attack (all guests – Nicholas Groom will teach)
Nicholas will be teaching an interactive dance for whoever wants to participate. (Open Dancing will follow)

Everybody Dances – upbeat music from oldie era (NO 90’s and up) AND Father of the Bride music (Steve Tyrell)
Examples: Great Balls of Fire, Firework (Katy Perry), Party in the USA (Miley Cyrus), Don’t Stop Believing, Funky Town, I’m A Believer, I Like to Move it Move it (Madagascar) → some of those are modern, but I’m ok with those

SONGS TO PLAY:
Inevitable – Anberlin
The Icarus Account – Angel of Mine
Hellogoodbye – Oh it is Love
Relient K – Must Have Done Something Right
The Way You look tonight – Steve Tyrell
Christina Perri – A Thousand Years
Michael Buble – Save the Last Dance for Me

Money Dance – “In the Mood” – Glenn Miller
6. Bouquet Toss – “Pretty Woman” – Roy Orbison
Garter Toss – “Someday Love Will Find You” – Journey (at chorus)
7. Cake Cutting – “L-O-V-E” – Nat King Cole
8. Dance Music – upbeat music from oldie era (NO 90’s and up) AND Father of the Bride music (Steve Tyrell)
9. Last Dance Song of the Night – “I Love You Because” – Jim Reeves https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nSs7o_-8i64 ~~~~NEW~~~~
(Bride & Groom Thank Their Guests)
Departure – Something upbeat
10 PM sparkler send off.
